write_up: Your resume points clearly to medical ICU nursing: you moved from telemetry at Saguaro Community Hospital to the medical ICU at Desert Valley Medical Center. A recruiter can see your patient load, clinical skills and Arizona license without guessing.

The line about caring for 2 critically ill patients per shift in a 24-bed medical ICU is a strong model. It puts your work and setting together. Your CCRN and ICU experience also sit where a recruiter can find them quickly.

Let's start with your charge nurse and sepsis committee work. Adding what you handled in those roles would show more of your contribution beyond direct patient care. Then give the telemetry rapid response line the same treatment.
